description: Find link paths between two notes. Returns all simple paths up to maxDepth edges, optionally including their shared neighbors. Broken-wikilink stub nodes are excluded by default — they are degree-1 dead ends in the undirected graph and will block legitimate paths if left in. Pass `includeStubs: true` to include them.

includeCommon.description: Also return notes that both `from` and `to` link to (shared neighbors).

includeStubs.description: Default `false`. Set `true` to include broken-wikilink stub nodes (`frontmatter._stub: true`) in the path search.

maxDepth.description: Maximum path length in hops. Default 3.

name: find_path_between
